# Generated by mods/cm_dev_perf/tools/port_from_cm_dev.py; not to be edited by hand.

# A right from the custom granter's list may go to this location. While the specialization
# draw is on, the location has no specialization yet (royal right or 1.4 charter) and the
# rights map scores one here (cm_trmm_best_mil, the draw's own order), the list holds back:
# - by default once the location holds a right, so a town keeps one right from the list and
#   the slot it gains as a city goes to the draw;
# - with «Сначала специализация» (cm_specialization_first) always, so the draw goes first.
# Before the draw's advance the location waits too: a granted right is not taken back.
# Root is the location, scope:cm_country set.
cm_perf_atr_leaves_room = {
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			scope:cm_country = { exists = var:cm_auto_grant_specialization }
			cm_atr_ur_has_no_specialization = yes
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_mil
			var:cm_trmm_best_mil > 0
			OR = {
				scope:cm_country = { exists = var:cm_specialization_first }
				has_any_town_rights = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
